name: Firewall policy mutation guard
summary: Block direct host firewall rule, policy, chain, and activation mutations.
description: A deterministic Claude Code PreToolUse gate for mutating iptables, nftables, UFW, firewalld, pfctl, and Windows Firewall commands while allowing inspection operations.
risk_reason: This automatic gate blocks direct host firewall rule, policy, chain, and activation mutations; a false denial can interrupt legitimate work, but it does not execute the blocked action.
refuses: It does not add, remove, flush, enable, or disable firewall rules.
It does not determine whether a port, address, zone, or rule is trustworthy.
It does not replace host isolation or network policy enforcement.

entrypoints.purpose: Recognize host firewall mutation verbs and refuse policy-changing commands.

linkReasons.hook/security/application-security/shell: firewall-policy-mutation-guard cannot see hidden commands (e.g. bash -c "$X"): shell-command-guard stops them.

operational.latency_reason: The entrypoint handles one intercepted event to block direct host firewall rule, policy, chain, and activation mutations without deferred work.
